heading: Today
text: Morning showers, mostly from the Green Mountains east, tapering off.  Increasing breaks of sun west to east this afternoon, with a few localized showers from the Adirondacks and Rt. 4 north.  Highs in the 70s, near 80 in the warmer valleys.  Winds south 10 to 15 mph, gusting to 25 mph, shifting to the west near 10 mph.

heading: Tonight
text: Any scattered evening showers ending.  Partial clearing, except clouds lingering through the higher terrain and Quebec.  Lows in the 50s to near 60.  Winds diminishing to light and variable.

heading: Friday
text: Partly sunny south.  Morning clouds north breaking for some sun, with localized showers, mainly in the afternoon from the northern Green Mountains east, and Rt. 2 north.  Highs in the 70s, near 70 over the higher terrain north.  Light winds freshening from the northwest 5 to 15 mph
